name: 57-emphasis-style-longhand
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 2; } .dot { text-emphasis-style: filled dot; } .ses { text-emphasis-style: open sesame; } .cir { text-emphasis-style: circle; text-emphasis-color: #0066cc; }
html:
text-emphasis-style: filled dot 只有样式没有简写。

text-emphasis-style: open sesame 芝麻点。

text-emphasis-style: circle 空心圆。
